In a few hours of flight, we cover surfaces that would take a surveyor several days to map on foot — with outputs directly importable into your GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS, AutoCAD Civil 3D).
Compared to traditional ground methods, drone photogrammetry offers:
: 50 hectares surveyed in one flight day versus several weeks with a total station
: the drone captures every point on the surface without blind spots (subject to tree cover)
: high-resolution orthophoto, DTM (digital terrain model), DSM (digital surface model) and 3D point cloud
: no plant machinery, no road closure required
